note: Hand-curated build data. Keep this SMALL and deliberate.
Only add builds that genuinely matter to somebody: the version known to work
with a popular mod setup, and the version known to break it. Everything else
the tool tries to label at runtime from Steam's own public events endpoint,
and shows unlabelled when Steam has nothing - which is common, because
developers frequently ship builds with no patch notes attached.
A missing label is not a problem. The tool identifies builds by when they
were installed and how much they were played, which works regardless.
Manifest IDs are global addresses on Valve's CDN, NOT per-machine values.
An entry harvested on one PC downloads correctly on any other PC whose
This file contains no personal data. Do not add account names, SteamIDs,
install paths or drive letters to it.

apps.name: ELDEN RING
launchNotes: If you use The Convergence, launch via ConvergenceER\Start_Convergence.bat.
If you use Seamless Co-op on its own, launch via ersc_launcher.exe.
Do NOT press Play in the Steam client - that starts the game through
anti-cheat instead of the mod loader.
